## Aim 2 MEG-fMRI Coupling (Left MTG)

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
subject = params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(params["export_dir"])
joined = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_trials_joined.csv")
joined.head()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(readr)
subject <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
joined <- read_csv(file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_trials_joined.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
joined$condition <- factor(joined$condition)
fit <- lmer(mtg_beta ~ prestim_beta + n400m + dci_trial + condition + pos_in_block + (1|block_id), data = joined)
print(summary(fit))
ggplot(joined, aes(x=prestim_beta, y=mtg_beta, color=condition)) + geom_point(alpha=.6) + geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE)
```
